name: "Wild Thing" Jonnie Adonis
caption: Won the 30-man over-the-top battle royal at the federation's first pay-per-view to become its first World Heavyweight Champion.

tenures.source: The promotion's own March Mayhem broadcast and a Thursday Night Thunder interview naming him the former champion the following month.

name: the Heartbreaker

name: Lord Doomsday
caption: Leader of the D.I.A. stable who held both the Hardcore and World Heavyweight Championships simultaneously and was the federation's last champion of record.

tenures.source: The promotion's own Mega Fight-era broadcasts through its final pay-per-view, November Armageddon.

name: Chris Hunter
caption: Won the World Heavyweight Championship at Cage Wars and fought Lord Doomsday to a one-hour draw in the federation's last pay-per-view.

tenures.source: The promotion's own Beachblast broadcast (billed "still HCW Triangle Champion") through its final pay-per-view.

name: "Franchise" Shane Dreamer
caption: Leader of the bWo who won the United States Championship at the federation's second pay-per-view.

tenures.source: The promotion's own Sneak Peek broadcast (the bWo's on-camera formation) through W.A.R., where he won the United States Championship.

name: Flash Flood
caption: The federation's first Hardcore Champion, named its Best Title Holder at the federation's own award show.

tenures.source: The promotion's own Sneak Peek broadcast through Beachblast, where he challenged for the title he once held.

name: Ben Toussi
caption: A bWo-adjacent wrestler credited in the federation's last pay-per-view as its own Executive Vice President and Webpage Master.
